"""Check V156 readiness bytes,sources,live prefix and current document links."""

import re
import time
from pathlib import Path

from train_directional_bank_trial import guard, read, ref, save

repo=Path('/home/dllu/proj/demosaic')
root=repo/'.cache/quality-20261103/V156-local-risk-v1'
index=repo/'docs/results/v156-local-risk-preparation-v1.json'
output=repo/'docs/results/v156-local-risk-preparation-verification-v1.json'
assert not output.exists()
publication=read(index)
assert len(publication['copies'])==12
for item in publication['copies'].values():
    assert ref(item['original']['path'])==item['original']
    assert ref(item['public']['path'])==item['public']
    assert Path(item['original']['path']).read_bytes()==Path(item['public']['path']).read_bytes()
plan=read(root/'plan-v1.json');guard(plan)
post=read(root/'postprocess-plan-v1.json');guard(post)
sources=read(publication['sources']['path'])
assert ref(publication['sources']['path'])==publication['sources']
assert len(sources['frozen_neural_hashes'])==86 and len(sources['source_texts'])==28
for p,h in sources['frozen_neural_hashes'].items():
    assert ref(p)['sha256']==ref(repo/'src/demosaic'/Path(p).name)['sha256']==h
for item in sources['source_texts']+[sources['publisher']]:
    assert ref(item['path'])['sha256']==item['sha256']
    assert Path(item['path']).read_text()==item['text']
for item in sources['metric_sources']:
    assert ref(item['path'])==item
assert read(root/'objective-tests-v1.json')['tests']==36
smoke=read(root/'smoke-result-v1.json')
assert smoke['counts']=={'mse-control':10,'local-risk':10}
assert all(min(v.values())>0 and len(v)==13 for v in smoke['parameter_maximum_gradients'].values())
assert read(root/'parity-result-v1.json')['component_forward_evaluations']==56
audit=read(root/'checkpoint500-audit-v1.json')
assert audit['control_raw_EMA_Adam_exact'] and audit['finite_Adam_states_at500']==26
assert not audit['CUDA_initialized']
snapshot=read(root/'live-readiness-v1.json')
assert snapshot['completed_training_prefix_rows']==808
assert (root/'train-trace-v1.jsonl').read_bytes().startswith(Path(snapshot['captured_journal_prefix']['path']).read_bytes())
for key in ['captured_status','captured_progress','captured_journal_prefix']:
    assert ref(snapshot[key]['path'])==snapshot[key]
assert read(root/'quality-design-v1.json')['new_component_forwards']==3288
assert len(read(root/'quality-design-v1.json')['endpoints'])==4
assert post['import_preflight']['returncode']==0
docs=['README.md','docs/index.md','docs/current-model.md','docs/research.md','docs/experiments.md',
      'docs/local-excess-risk.md','diary/2026-11-03-20-27-30-v156-local-excess-risk.md']
links=0
for name in docs:
    p=repo/name
    for link in re.findall(r'!?\[[^\]]*\]\(([^)]+)\)',p.read_text()):
        if '://' in link or link.startswith('#'):continue
        assert (p.parent/link.split('#')[0]).is_file(),(name,link)
        links+=1
save(output,{
    'status':'pass-preparation-bytes-sources-and-documents-quality-pending',
    'recorded_unix_UTC':time.time(),'publication':ref(index),'byte_exact_receipts':12,
    'source_texts':28,'unchanged_neural_sources':86,'tests':36,'compatibility_head_calls':56,
    'discarded_smoke_head_calls':20,'finite_Adam_states_at500':26,'historical_live_prefix_rows':808,
    'document_links_checked':links,'documents':{p:ref(repo/p) for p in docs},
    'verifier':dict(ref(Path(__file__)),text=Path(__file__).read_text()),
    'new_neural_calls':0,'new_noise_draws':0,
    'scope':'Exact12 copied receipt bytes,28 source texts,86 unchanged neural hashes,real compatibility/smoke/step500 proof and historical live prefix. Does not imply final quality,local safety,completed production or actual new native viewing.'})
print('PASS:12 byte-exact readiness copies,28 source texts,86 neural hashes,36 tests,808-row prefix,',links,'links;quality pending')
